notes.title: PlayStation, Xbox and Nintendo Switch
notes.content:

notes.title: Achievement bonanza and leaderboard changes in v1.4.5
notes.content:
Hello there fellow Snake lovers!

It has been a very long time since we made any announcements on this game although we've been making tiny updates in the background but now we have some major news: [b]We are proud to announce that Snake vs Snake is finally coming to PlayStation. [/b]

During the work with the PlayStation port we decided to also update our Steam version. 

[b]New achievements[/b]
We've increased the number of achievements from 2 to 14. We also replaced the achievement that required you to reach the #1 spot in any leaderboard as this wasn't fair to players as it would become increasingly more difficult to reach the #1 spot over time. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34478103/403c335a4c0e3eec6898f8b1ebb6a41596b6d18d.png[/img]

[b]Where is my highscore on the leaderboard?[/b]
Another big change is that we have swapped out our legacy leaderboard with Steams leaderboards. In some cases this means that your old score isn't recorded on Steam, sadly we cannot add them either. 

The good part however with this system is that scores are permanent and it also supports more players than the previous top 100 players. You also have the option to only see your steam friends. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34478103/814e9c5950d7e61738d96bba07911895e99ff232.png[/img]

We hope to see your name on the leaderboard soon!

notes.title: Update v1.3.6 is out!
notes.content:
One of our [url=https://discord.gg/AyYtKXT]Discord [/url]members, Neube, requested to have a volume slider in the game for the SFX. It's a great suggestion and it should have been in the game from the start but was lost somewhere in the development process. 

Keep the suggestions coming and feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/AyYtKXT]Discord Server[/url]

Change log:
v1.3.6
* New feature: Ability to adjust SFX volume
* Improved: Volume UI works more like sliders now. You can use the stick to increase/decrease volume
* Improved: Reduced the sfx volume when you pickup an apple

notes.title: Update v1.3.5 is out!
notes.content:
I got a feature request from a player asking for the option to disable power-ups in the Tail Runner battle mode so he could be able to play the game "Tron lightbike" style. In the patch I took this one step further so you can disable power-ups in all battle modes so you can also play regular Snake and use more tactics to win against your opponents. 

Contrasts on some of the power-ups have been improved as requested by another player. 

A bug that causes snakes to re-spawn when you added a new AI opponent has also been fixed. 

Keep sending feedback and don't by shy to send feature requests.
